# GRE Quant 6-Week Study Roadmap

A focused plan built around your time budget: **90 minutes on weekdays, 3 hours on Saturdays, Sundays off**. It prioritizes **algebra and data interpretation first**, keeps **arithmetic active**, and uses **geometry as maintenance** so you improve where it matters most.

## 6-Week GRE Quant Plan

| Week | Dates | Focus | Key Sessions | Goal / Quiz |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Mon–Sat | Diagnostic + algebra foundations | Baseline timed set; equations/inequalities; word-to-equation translation; error log setup | Identify top 3 weakness types; 25-question mixed quiz |
| 2 | Mon–Sat | Algebra core | Linear equations; systems; exponents/roots; factoring; quadratic basics | Improve accuracy on algebra drills to 70%+ |
| 3 | Mon–Sat | Data interpretation + arithmetic refresh | Tables/graphs; averages; ratios; percentages; unit conversions | Faster reading of charts; 30-question DI + arithmetic set |
| 4 | Mon–Sat | Mixed problem solving | Algebra + arithmetic mixed sets; rate/work; probability basics; geometry review | Build endurance; 1 timed section midweek |
| 5 | Mon–Sat | Test-style practice | Two timed quant sections; review traps; pacing drills; geometry maintenance | Raise pacing to target; full error analysis |
| 6 | Mon–Sat | Final polish + practice test | Full-length practice test; deep review; weakest-topic repair; light final drills | Lock in timing and confidence; final score estimate |

## Weekly Topic Order and Session Structure

### Week 1: Diagnose and rebuild the base
- **Weekday plan:**
  - Mon: diagnostic quant set + mistake log
  - Tue: algebra fundamentals
  - Wed: equations and inequalities
  - Thu: translating word problems into equations
  - Fri: mixed review of the week
- **Saturday:** longer timed set, then review every miss
- **Goal:** find the patterns behind mistakes, not just the wrong answers

### Week 2: Algebra core
- **Topic order:** linear equations → systems → exponents and roots → factoring → quadratics
- **Weekday plan:** one concept per day, then 10–15 targeted questions
- **Saturday:** 45–60 minute mixed algebra practice under time
- **Goal:** make algebra feel routine instead of slow

### Week 3: Data interpretation + arithmetic refresh
- **Topic order:** charts and tables → averages → ratios → percentages → units
- **Weekday plan:** alternate DI and arithmetic so both stay active
- **Saturday:** one DI-heavy timed set plus review of shortcuts
- **Goal:** read visuals faster and avoid careless computation errors

### Week 4: Mixed problem solving
- **Topic order:** rates/work → probability basics → mixed algebra/arithmetic → geometry maintenance
- **Weekday plan:** mixed sets to force switching between topics
- **Saturday:** timed section simulation with pacing checkpoints
- **Goal:** improve adaptability and reduce topic-switching mistakes

### Week 5: Test-style practice
- **Topic order:** full mixed sets → pacing drills → review of recurring error types
- **Weekday plan:** 1 timed mini-set on 3 days, 2 review-focused days
- **Saturday:** two timed quant sections with a short break between
- **Goal:** build test stamina without overloading

### Week 6: Final polish
- **Topic order:** full practice test → review → weakest-topic repair → light refresh
- **Weekday plan:** one major review area per day, no marathon sessions
- **Saturday:** full-length practice test, then review only the highest-value misses
- **Goal:** enter test week sharp, not exhausted

## Daily Study Template

- **Weekdays, 90 minutes**
  - 10 min: warm-up and formula recall
  - 35 min: concept or targeted drill
  - 30 min: timed practice set
  - 15 min: review mistakes and update log

- **Saturdays, 3 hours**
  - 20 min: warm-up
  - 60 min: timed practice or section simulation
  - 60 min: deep review of every missed or guessed question
  - 40 min: targeted repair set on weak areas

## Practice Test Timing

- **End of Week 1:** short diagnostic, not a full test
- **End of Week 3 or mid-Week 4:** first timed quant section under realistic conditions
- **Week 5 Saturday:** two timed quant sections back-to-back
- **Week 6 Saturday:** full-length practice test

## Progress Tracking Without Burning Out

### Track these 5 metrics
- **Accuracy by topic**: algebra, DI, arithmetic, geometry
- **Time per question**: especially on DI and algebra
- **Miss type**: concept gap, careless error, misread, time pressure
- **Confidence rating**: 1–5 after each set
- **Energy level**: quick note before and after study

### Keep the log simple
Use one line per missed question:
- Topic
- Why missed
- Correct method
- What to do next

### Burnout prevention rules
- Keep **Sundays fully off**
- Stop a session if focus drops sharply for more than 10 minutes
- Use **one lighter day** each week after the hardest Saturday review
- Limit full-length tests to the planned weeks only
- Rotate problem types so every day does not feel identical
